entries.subject: electric vehicles
entries.quote: Passenger EV sales continue to rise in 2026, reaching 23.3 million globally, despite regulatory changes putting markets on divergent trajectories.
entries.note: Current-year forecast. The press release says 'Over 23 million'.

entries.subject: electric vehicles
entries.metric: EV share of new car sales, global
entries.quote: BloombergNEF expects over a quarter (27%) of cars sold globally in 2026 to be electric

entries.subject: electric vehicles
entries.metric: EV share of new passenger vehicle sales, global
entries.quote: over half (52%) of all passenger vehicles to be electric by 2035
entries.note: The press release wording does not say 'sales'; BNEF's EVO landing page says 'Electric passenger vehicles surpass 50% of sales' by 2035, and press reports it as a sales share. Read as sales share.

entries.subject: electric vehicles
entries.metric: EV share of new car, van and truck sales, global
entries.quote: Over two-thirds of car, van and truck sales are electric
entries.note: Stated as 'over two-thirds' of car, van and truck sales combined, not passenger cars alone. Landing-page milestone, year 2040.

entries.subject: electric vehicles
entries.metric: year electric passenger vehicles on the road outnumber ICE vehicles
entries.quote: Electric passenger vehicles on the road outnumber internal combustion engine vehicles

notes: Latest edition. Scenario named in the release: Economic Transition Scenario (ETS). Price: BEVs still 17% more expensive than ICE cars in Germany, Italy and UK, down from a 34% premium in 2024 (status, not a forecast year). No global 2030 sales figure in the public release; China 52% of global EV sales in 2030 (regional, not captured).
